Roll-forward: 1,522,087 + 938,940 - 469,978 + 32,977 unrealized gain (other_financing) + 93,129 net transfers in = 2,117,155. Business-type (Electric, Water, Sewer, Sanitation) from the proprietary Statement of Revenues, Expenses and Changes in Net Position Total column (p9): 2,988,301 + 1,635,915 - 1,312,721 - 93,129 = 3,218,366. Balance sheet: government-wide Statement of Net Position (p1), which includes capital assets and debt (governmental funds total 2,117,155 differs from net position 2,626,356).
